description.short_caption: Ulcerated lesion with surrounding erythema on the arm.
description.detailed_description: This image shows an ulcerated lesion on the arm with a dark, necrotic center surrounded by erythema. The lesion is circumscribed with a pen marking, likely for monitoring progression. The surrounding skin appears inflamed, with no visible signs of drainage or crusting. The lesion is suggestive of a localized infectious or inflammatory process.

description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-positive bacilli from a skin biopsy.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of a skin biopsy under a microscope. Numerous slender, rod-shaped organisms are visible, staining pink to red, consistent with gram-positive bacilli. The background appears relatively clear, with minimal cellular debris. The organisms are scattered throughout the field, with some clustering noted.
visible_findings: pink to red staining consistent with gram-positive bacilli
scattered and clustered distribution of organisms
